articles.title: Dr. Phil accuses US government of lying ‘straight to our face’ for ignoring legitimate UFO reports
articles.summary: Phil accuses US government of lying ‘straight to our face’ for ignoring legitimate UFO reports See more of our coverage in your search results. Phil McGraw accused the Pentagon of lying “straight to our face” and ignoring the massive number of UFO sightings reported by the general public — despite civilians being responsible for seeing the majority of the activity. The famed TV host sensationally claimed Wednesday that there has been “a conscious, policy-driven decision to deceive the American people about what was going on in the skies” for decades — and that “we’re not getting the truth from our government. ” “[The government] has turned a blind eye to sightings by most Americans,” McGraw said in a video posted on his X account.

articles.title: Pentagon seeks access to vast private UFO records collection
articles.summary: Pentagon seeks access to vast private UFO records collection The Pentagon recently moved to issue a sole-source contract to a New Mexico-based nonprofit corporation that reportedly holds North America’s largest private collection of historical records documenting unidentified anomalous phenomena, including heaps of exclusive UFO case files that exist outside of the U. Details about the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office’s plans to buy a commercial data subscription to scrutinize the National Unidentified Flying Object Historic Records Center’s archives — and specifically, materials that pre-date 1990 — were first revealed in a recent Defense Department contracting notice.

One of the prominent concept artists who got to work on Steven Spielberg's Disclosure Day was Daniel Baker and recently he's taken to social media to debut some of the phenomenal artwork he provided for the film! articles.title: The Evidence Around UAPs Is Getting Harder to Ignore
articles.summary: png) 0:00 -10:15 Audio 3 Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence – such is the case on Non-Human Intelligence (NHI) and Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAPs). I have had no personal firsthand experience with either, but there is evidence mounting, and it has been significant enough that it has captured my attention. I want to share the way I think about this — not as a believer, not as a skeptic, but as someone who takes data seriously enough to know when too much is happening not to pay attention. On August 31, 2026, at the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, the UAP Science Advisory Council was informed that the United States government has a ‘**preparedness plan in place’** should the existence of nonhuman intelligence (NHI) be confirmed.

de.title: Die Beweise für UAPs werden immer schwerer zu ignorieren
de.summary: png) 0:00 -10:15 Audio 3 Außergewöhnliche Ansprüche erfordern außergewöhnliche Beweise – dies ist der Fall bei nicht-menschlicher Intelligenz (nhi) und nicht identifizierten anomalen Phänomenen (UAPs). Ich habe keine persönlichen Erfahrungen aus erster Hand mit beiden gemacht, aber es gibt immer mehr Beweise, und es war signifikant genug, dass es meine Aufmerksamkeit erregt hat. Ich möchte die Art und Weise teilen, wie ich darüber denke — nicht als Gläubiger, nicht als Skeptiker, sondern als jemand, der Daten aufnimmt ernst genug, um zu wissen, wann zu viel passiert, um nicht darauf zu achten.

articles.title: Exeter UFO Festival 2026: Your complete guide to out-of-this-world speakers and events
articles.summary: Exeter UFO Festival 2026: Your complete guide to out-of-this-world speakers and events - The Exeter UFO Festival is a Labor Day weekend tradition celebrating the 1965 "Incident at Exeter. " - Hosted by the Exeter-Area Kiwanis Club, the two-day event features UFO expert talks, a parade, and an alien costume contest. - Activities include trolley rides to the 1965 sighting location and continuous showings of historical videos. - Proceeds from the festival and a special police patch sale support local children's charities and scholarships. If you’ve walked through downtown Exeter lately, you may have spotted neon‑green alien faces peering from storefronts and posters — a sure sign that the UFO Festival is about to return.
